nodes.name: Synthesis of the MnOx-precursor
nodes.procedure: 200 mg of MnSO4.H2O and 125 mg of NH4H2PO4 were dissolved in 15 mL of water. 15 mL of KMnO4 aqueous solution (10 mg mL-1) was added slowly to the MnSO4 / NH4H2PO4 mixture under vigorous stirring for 2 h. The solid product (MnOx-precursor) was recovered by centrifugation, washed with water, and vacuum dried in 60 C air overnight.

nodes.name: Synthesis of IrSA-MnOx
nodes.procedure: MnOx-precursor (100 mg) was well dispersed in 100 mL water and continuously ultrasonicated for 10 min. IrCl3 (100 mg) was well dispersed in 100 mL water and continuously ultrasonicated for 60 min (pH = 2.5). Subsequently, IrCl3 solution was slowly added to the MnOx-precursor solution and magnetically stirred for 24 h. The solid product was recovered by centrifugation, washed with water, and vacuum dried in 60 C air overnight. The dried product was then annealed in air at 350 C, with a heating rate of 5 C min-1. The annealed sample was washed with water several times again and was vacuum dried at 60 C to obtain the IrSA-MnOx.

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS shows Mn-O and Mn-Mn shells similar to MnO2; Ir L3-edge shows Ir-O coordination shell at 1.5 Angstrom; wavelet transforms suggest Ir-Mn/Ir-P coordination rather than Ir-Ir.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Mn K-edge EXAFS spectra ... both show two prominent peaks at about 1.4 and 2.5 A ... FT-EXAFS profile of IrSA-MnOx shows a prominent peak at 1.5 A that corresponds to the first Ir-O coordination shell ... Ir-Mn/Ir-P coordination is more likely to exist in IrSA-MnOx , rather than Ir-Ir coordination

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows MnO6 vibrations for both; IrSA-MnOx shows structural stability during electrocatalysis, whereas MnOx undergoes reconstruction to Mn3O4 during ORR.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectra of IrSA-MnOx under different potentials compared to that of MnOx ... MnOx sample shows a distinctive behavior ... A new band v4(669 cm-1) appears, which could be assigned to ... Mn3O4 phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ ATR-SEIRA identifies direct O-O coupling (1200 cm-1) on IrSA-MnOx during OER, whereas MnOx shows dominant OOH intermediates (AEM mechanism).
nodes.evidence_snippet: peak at 1200 cm-1 could be ascribed to the formation of O - O bond ... direct O - O coupling is the dominant mechanism for OER on IrSA MnOx. In contrast, for the MnOx sample, the OOH intermediate dominantly formed
